Theorem
[Odd-dimensional positive-curvature gap theorem] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0330 1. ch15:15.41\group Applications of Harnack Estimates

If $(\mathcal M^{2k+1},g)$ is complete, noncompact, and has positive sectional curvature, then its asymptotic scalar-curvature ratio is positive.
